races.paceDynamic: Travis, Filey Beach, and Langholm will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the final furlong, creating separation between horses. The relentless gallop will suit those with proven staying power who can quicken off a solid pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can benefit from the strong tempo and finish with a flourish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Travis, Filey Beach and Langholm all go forward and maintain a fierce gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runners in the final furlong, allowing patient hold-up horses with finishing kicks to sweep past tired leaders. Closers with proven stamina at the trip will have ideal conditions to unleash their best.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners neutralise each other early and the pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: A slower tempo will favour those tracking in prominent positions who can sustain their effort when the race develops. Horses with tactical speed positioned just behind the leaders will have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals March
scenarios.trigger: If one of Travis, Filey Beach or Langholm gets an uncontested lead while the others fade
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left in reserve to hold off late challengers, especially with the apprentice weight allowances. Travis looks best positioned of the three with recent consistent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is brisk but not punishing, creating an even contest
scenarios.body: The race becomes a straight test of ability with no tactical advantage to any particular running style. Class and current form become the primary factors in determining the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Travis, Filey Beach and Langholm all showing early speed - if all three go forward together the pace will be unsustainably fast
Mount Ruapehu and Asian Journey settling towards rear early - they need the expected strong pace to set up their finishing kicks
Coconut Bay and How Impressive tracking the leaders in midfield - their positions after two furlongs will indicate tactical intentions
Carlton And Co and Patontheback both returning from long breaks - watch for signs of needed race fitness in the paddock
The apprentice riders taking significant weight off - watch how Langley on Filey Beach and Tuke on Mount Ruapehu handle the tactical demands

races.paceDynamic: Big Shot Veto will take them along from the front with no obvious challenger for the early lead, creating a measured tempo over this 7f trip. Highland Shah, Lightening Lad, Sandy Craic, Zarvali, Different Opinions and Pennine Way will settle in the chasing pack behind the leader. The lack of genuine pace pressure on Big Shot Veto means he can dictate terms and potentially steal a march, while the hold-up horses Pacific Glory, Vega Storm, Alcanzor and Tickhill Flyer will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the lone front-runner who can control the gallop without harassment.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Big Shot Veto gets an easy lead and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The leader dictates a steady pace before quickening when it matters, making it difficult for closers to peg him back. His class edge and tactical advantage prove decisive with the prominent racers filling the places.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers gets first run on Big Shot Veto
scenarios.body: Sandy Craic or Zarvali use their higher RPR ratings to challenge turning in, overhauling the tiring leader in the final furlong. The measured pace suits their style perfectly as they can time their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the home straight
scenarios.body: Pacific Glory or Vega Storm get a perfectly timed ride from the back, swooping late as the leaders tire. The tactical contest becomes a sprint finish that suits their closing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to handle the return from breaks
scenarios.body: Different Opinions capitalizes on race fitness while the market principals disappoint after lengthy layoffs. The consistent performer benefits from a truly-run race that exposes the rustiness of others.

watchPoints.text: Big Shot Veto needs to show he's retained his ability after 193 days off the track
Sandy Craic and Zarvali both carry strong credentials but must overcome significant layoffs
Pacific Glory has the recent run advantage that could prove crucial if others show rust
The apprentice allowance for Pennine Way could be vital if the weights are tight
Highland Shah's headgear suggests connections expect improvement from his return

runners_data.note: Natural front-runner likely to get uncontested lead but form has declined and may struggle to sustain gallop

races.paceDynamic: Zimmerman will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, as Laravie is the only other prominent runner and tends to settle just off the pace rather than challenge early. This creates a sustainable tempo through the early stages of the 2-mile trip, with the large pack of hold-up horses (Bouboule, Wasthatok, Stellarmasterpiece, Stand Strong, Himself, Arctic Fox) tracking behind. The race will develop into a sprint finish as the hold-up brigade fan out wide in the straight, but the even gallop will suit those who can position prominently and avoid the traffic that six closers will create. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can avoid getting shuffled back in the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Zimmerman and Laravie control the tempo without being pressured by the hold-up horses until late
scenarios.body: The even pace allows the front pair to kick clear in the straight before the closers can organise their challenge. Laravie's superior recent form and Hollie Doyle's tactical awareness prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six closers all get caught behind each other turning for home and struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: The bunching creates a messy finish where only the horses with the clearest runs can capitalise. Stellarmasterpiece and Arctic Fox benefit from being drawn better positioned than their hold-up rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Zimmerman sets too strong a pace trying to get away from the large field of closers
scenarios.body: The early burn-up sets up a perfect scenario for the freshest hold-up horse to sweep past a tiring field. Wasthatok's recent win and Kevin Stott's patience become crucial advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Laravie decides to challenge Zimmerman early and they go too fast through the middle sections
scenarios.body: Both prominent runners tie up badly in the final furlong, leaving the race at the mercy of whichever hold-up horse gets the first clear run. Stand Strong's 214-day break becomes an asset in a slowly-run finish.

watchPoints.text: Zimmerman may get an easy lead but his recent form suggests he could fold quickly when challenged
Traffic problems are inevitable with six hold-up horses needing room simultaneously in the home straight
Stand Strong returning after 214 days with inexperienced jockey may struggle tactically in this field size
Laravie's positioning behind Zimmerman will be crucial to avoid getting trapped behind the wall of closers
Arctic Fox and Stellarmasterpiece need to be handier than usual to avoid the closing traffic jam

races.paceDynamic: Soul Seeker will take the field along as the sole confirmed leader, setting a controlled pace without pressure from other front-runners. Irish Dancer, Golden Prosperity, Lady Bouquet and Ninety Nine will sit prominently behind, while the majority including Newyorkstateofmind, Monticristo Boy, Siviez, Hi Hoh Tonto, Aurora's Doublesix and Hyrcanian are hold-up horses. The lack of early pace pressure creates a tactical race where the prominent runners can position themselves perfectly for a sustained drive. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Soul Seeker and have the pace to quicken when the leader inevitably weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker sets predictable fractions and the prominent runners time their moves perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Irish Dancer and Golden Prosperity to sit in the perfect striking positions and unleash superior finishing kicks. Soul Seeker's moderate ability means he cannot sustain his lead against classier horses timing their runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The stop-start nature catches the prominent runners out of their rhythm while fresh hold-up horses like Newyorkstateofmind and Monticristo Boy can produce devastating late surges. The tactical nature suits patient jockeys who can weave through traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soul Seeker Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can organize a serious challenge to Soul Seeker's uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The leader gets such an easy time in front that he builds an unassailable advantage entering the final furlong. By the time the field responds it's too late as Soul Seeker has already secured enough daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners interfere with each other in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The crowded prominent positions lead to traffic problems and checking, allowing a smooth-travelling outsider from the back to sweep up on the outside. The race becomes a lottery decided by who gets the clearest passage.

watchPoints.text: Soul Seeker could steal this if he gets completely uncontested fractions and builds an unassailable lead
Multiple prominent runners Irish Dancer, Golden Prosperity and Lady Bouquet could interfere with each other in the closing stages
The large contingent of hold-up horses need Soul Seeker to go faster early than his natural inclination
Several horses including Siviez, Aurora's Doublesix and Hyrcanian have shown concerning fade-in-finish patterns recently
Both Philip Kirby runners Soul Seeker and Lady Bouquet are drawn together and could work in tandem early

races.paceDynamic: Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory will contest the early lead, with Inspiring Speeches showing stronger recent front-running form and likely to dictate. Six horses (Free Pic, Prince Hector, Tracker Issue, The Pug, Falaise Blanc, Lawmans Blis) all want prominent positions behind the leaders, creating inevitable traffic problems approaching the home turn. The large field of 14 runners over 1m4f at Catterick will see the pace honest but not frantic, with the real race beginning 3f out when the prominent runners start their moves. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and find clear runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get bunched up 3f out as expected
scenarios.body: The early pace battle between Inspiring Speeches and Sassy Glory sets it up perfectly for closers to sweep past the traffic-affected prominent brigade. Desert Quest, Rock Armour, Muhib and Stitching Wheel all have the tactical profile to benefit from the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Free Pic Escapes Trouble
scenarios.trigger: If Free Pic can secure an uncontested position just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The in-form gelding has won his last two races and can use his class advantage to kick clear before the traffic builds up behind him. His recent victories show he's peaking at the right time and can dominate this grade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Inspiring Speeches gets an easy lead with Sassy Glory settling
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine early pace allows the leader to dictate fractions and save enough for the finish, while the prominent horses still get in each other's way. Inspiring Speeches has won from the front before and can repeat the trick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Raysham Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace truly collapses and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The Carroll-trained four-year-old has solid recent form and could benefit from a truly-run race where his finishing kick becomes decisive. His trainer's 4/14 record suggests horses are running well and he's unexposed at this trip.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe congestion 3f out involving Free Pic, Prince Hector, Tracker Issue, The Pug, Falaise Blanc and Lawmans Blis all trying to improve position simultaneously.
Monitor how much rope Inspiring Speeches gets in front - if uncontested early he could steal a march on the field.
Check if Desert Quest can overcome his 60-day layoff as his hold-up style is perfectly suited to this race shape.
Watch Tracker Issue closely on return from 109-day break - talented but the layoff is a major concern.
Observe Muhib's position early as he's drawn low but needs to be held up to be effective.

races.paceDynamic: Homestrait will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely getting an easy lead with North West Gal, Lily Pearl, Betties Bay and Miss Rainbow all settling just behind in the prominent positions. The pace will be steady rather than frantic with no obvious pace pressure, allowing Homestrait to dictate terms through the early stages before the prominent group closes from the 2f pole. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground from the back in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the prominent group gets first run
scenarios.body: The tracking horses get ideal positioning to strike approaching the final furlong while hold-up runners are left with too much to do. North West Gal and Lily Pearl are perfectly placed to capitalize on their racing styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kick from the back. Surprised and Pull The Rug can use their stamina to run down tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Homestrait gets completely uncontested fractions and the field sleeps
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable advantage as the field fails to apply early pressure. Homestrait dictates throughout and holds off all challengers despite modest recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If they go so slow it becomes a 1f dash
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where early position matters less than instant acceleration. The field bunches up completely before a mad dash where TopSpeed ratings become crucial.

watchPoints.text: Homestrait may get completely uncontested lead and steal a march if the prominent group fails to apply early pressure
Miss Rainbow wearing visor for first time which could sharpen her up significantly or cause concentration issues
North West Gal and Lily Pearl both returning from extended breaks, watch for any market confidence
The pace could completely collapse in small field leaving hold-up horses Surprised and Arctic Summer with impossible task
Betties Bay carrying 139lbs after recent wins, watch if the weight stops her finishing kick
